d: Manchester United, one of the biggest clubs in football. With 20 titles, they have the joint-most English top flight title wins, along with Liverpool. The last time they did so was during Sir Alex Ferguson’s final season in 2013. United now find themselves in the relegation zone and only one point ahead of the bottom-placed Crystal Palace as the international break is under way. They have also announced the sacking of Michael Carrick and the introduction of Mauricio Pochettino to replace him.
